definition: Functional maker devices, controllers, display systems and radio nodes with GPIO or documented internal signal access; not every bare microcontroller board.

records.note: M5Stack marks packaging and software as work in progress; features and documentation may change.

watchlist.name: T-Glass V3
watchlist.note: Official repository provides GPIO tables and a schematic. A physical device pinout image was not found in the inspected repository; older T-Glass artwork is not substituted.

watchlist.name: T-Glass V2
watchlist.note: Official repository inspected. Orientation pictures and software screenshots are not physical pinout sheets.

watchlist.name: T-Beam 1W LR2021
watchlist.note: The manufacturer documents an LR2021 radio variant. The collected SX1262 T-Beam 1W sheet is not assigned to this variant without verification.

watchlist.name: Bus Pirate 5 REV10
watchlist.note: Official hardware documentation is available. A complete, original physical I/O pinout image still needs collecting; the WiPhone daughter board is a different product.
